description: Na₈Mg(CoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.37 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.50 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.55 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.50 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.46 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three CoO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.60 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.36 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with two NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.98 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.98 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄MgCo octahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄MgCo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form distorted ONa₅Co octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₄MgCo octahedra and edges with three ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom.
